artifacts.title: Research: Which SQLite library?
artifacts.markdown:
## Question
Which SQLite library should the todo store use?

## Recommendation
Use the built-in `node:sqlite`: no dependency, enough for one table.

## Options compared
| Option | Cost | Gives |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `node:sqlite` | none | sync API, built in |
| `better-sqlite3` | native build | faster, more features |

## Evidence
- Node docs, `node:sqlite` page (2026).

## Risks and open questions
- Still marked experimental in some Node versions.

proposedTickets.descriptionMd: Replace the in-memory store in `src/todos.js` with `node:sqlite`, as recommended in the research.
